name: error-summary
description: What stopped a form, at the top, as a list: each problem in plain words, linking to the field it is about.

use.when: a form was sent and one or more of its answers could not be taken.
use.not: a problem that is not about a field, which is an alert; a field's own message, which sits with the field.
use.with: the same message beside each field, tied to it.

title.description: What happened, such as Not saved.

id.description: Its id; each problem is this id and its number, which the field it names is described by. Change it only on a page with two.

text.description: The problem and how to fix it: Due is not a day; say it like 19 Sep.

field.description: The field it is about, by name; its link goes there and the field is marked with it.

href.description: Where the link goes, when not a field of this form.

a11y.role: alert, holding a heading and a list of links

keyboard.does: moves focus to the field it is about

wcag.notes: Announced as an alert when it arrives (4.1.3), and the problems are listed where the form starts, each saying how to fix it (3.3.3) and leading to its field. With scripts, each field it names is marked aria-invalid and described by its problem (3.3.1).

machine.identify: Each link is one problem; data-field names the field, as the form sends it (prop-<name> in the inline editor).
machine.operate: Read the problems, fix each field it names, and send the form again.

items.text: Due is not a day; say it like 19 Sep.
